description: This file implements the StandardJavaEngine class, which is a service engine in the Apache OFBiz framework responsible for executing Java static methods as services. It extends a generic asynchronous engine and provides methods for synchronous execution of services that invoke static Java methods via reflection.

classes.name: StandardJavaEngine
classes.description: A service engine class executing static Java methods as services within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: runSyncIgnore
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously, ignoring the result.

methods.name: runSync
methods.description: Executes a service synchronously and returns the result as a Map.

methods.name: serviceInvoker
methods.description: Invokes a static Java method specified in the service configuration using reflection.
